summary: A Yes vote establishes a half-cent (0.5%) sales tax to fund city services including police, fire, and 911 emergency response.

tax.text: The Yes side supports a half-cent sales-tax increase to fund public safety, parks, and other core city services.
tax.quote: A simple majority (50%+) vote is required for Measure C to pass. a “YES vote” supports the half cent sales tax increase proposal; a “NO vote” rejects the proposal.
